segments.text: The first story is about Phil and Luke. Luke has been riding his sister’s old bike because Claire does not think he is responsible enough to own a new one. Phil disagrees and buys him a brand-new bike, hoping that Luke will prove he can take care of it.

segments.text: The second story is about Jay and Manny. Gloria asks them to install a ceiling fan together so that they can become closer. Jay ignores the instructions, while Manny keeps warning him about safety. They argue and say some hurtful things.

segments.text: Overall, the episode shows that parents often make mistakes while trying to do the right thing. As Jay says near the end, ninety percent of being a dad is just showing up.
